Home / For automotive paintshops

One qualified supplier for your entire paintshop.

Covers, masking, wiping, defect correction and QC support — one vendor number, one delivery, one person who answers the phone.

Every new supplier costs your plant a registration, an audit and an SAP vendor number. System.aero consolidates five paintshop consumable categories under one qualified vendor: robot covers, masking tapes, tack cloths and wipes, one-step defect correction, and paint thickness QC support.

Walk the line

  • Booth — covered robots, zero fiber contamination
  • Masking — clean lines through the oven
  • Prep — tack-off before every coat
  • Finish — one-pass spot repair
  • QC — coating thickness checks

We already deliver into OEM and tier-1 paintshops in Poland and Europe — 7 plants and counting.
